about: Niagara Falls is on the Niagara River in Ontario, opposite the American city of the same name. The Horseshoe Falls and a long hydroelectric history underpin a major tourism strip of hotels, parks, and viewpoints. The Niagara Parkway and the Niagara Escarpment wine belt sit immediately beside the built-up core. About 94,000 people live in Niagara Falls.
seoSummary: Ontario city at Horseshoe Falls, a hydroelectric and tourism centre on the Niagara River.
